input_usuario: Liste os 5 cargos com maior remuneração média em 2024.
query_referencia: WITH sal AS (SELECT dsc_cargo, seq_dim_pessoa, MAX(CAST(vlr_rmn_liquida AS DECIMAL)) AS salario FROM remuneracao_municipio WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 GROUP BY dsc_cargo, seq_dim_pessoa) SELECT dsc_cargo, AVG(salario) AS media FROM sal GROUP BY dsc_cargo ORDER BY media DESC LIMIT 5;
query_gerada: WITH remuneracao_2024 AS (SELECT r.dsc_cargo, AVG(CAST(r.vlr_rmn_liquida AS DECIMAL)) AS media_remuneracao FROM remuneracao_municipio r JOIN pessoa_municipio p ON r.seq_dim_pessoa = p.seq_dim_pessoa WHERE r.ano_referencia = 2024 AND r.dsc_sit_serv_pens ILIKE '%Ativo%' AND COALESCE(p.nom_pessoa, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%' GROUP BY r.dsc_cargo) SELECT dsc_cargo, media_remuneracao FROM remuneracao_2024 ORDER BY media_remuneracao DESC LIMIT 5;
